description: A scatter of little teeth, none of them matching. Small things lose them; smaller things collect them.
lore: Six gold the scatter, which does not cover the stooping, and every bag in the trade has some in the bottom seam regardless. You pick them up without deciding to. Then the bag goes on the counter, out they come with the sweepings, and the trader takes them by weight at a price he did not set and tips them into a barrel with everything else too small to have a name.

Ask who buys a barrel of teeth and he will tell you the truth, which is that he has no idea. The order comes down the road, the barrel goes up it, the gold comes back, and it has worked that way longer than he has been standing there. [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] has followed that road three times and come back with three answers, each of them a further stretch of road.
gm_notes: The unexplained buyer of junk, spent once and kept unexplained. Bettany has an open file on it and three dead ends. Do not resolve; do not connect it to the mountain in shipped text.
